airManifest.scope: AIR operation/type reconstruction. Half arithmetic uses float32 and explicit RTE before half assignments. Recorded single-use fast multiply followed by fast add/sub uses FMA when enabled, skipping intermediate product rounding as permitted by original fast flags. Original cloud 3D descriptors use float32 texelFetch interpolation over unchanged upload bytes. Parallel phi, Metal projection and float32 external interfaces retained. Undef/poison and padding use deterministic zero. Vulkan fast intrinsics and contraction choices are not guaranteed equal to original Metal hardware or game images.

reference: Original AIR SSA/branches/casts retargeted by LLVM to Linux AArch64 at O0, explicit CPU intrinsics and float32 sampler
scope: Original three depth AIR stages executed through the production Vulkan depth-chain entry. Original RGBA16F opaque signed-alpha input and RG16F/RGBA16F/RG16F floor-divided targets, nearest clamp, shader-generated indexed fullscreen vertex IDs. Explicit test dimensions, half-size/jitter uniforms and depth patterns include negative/positive depths, signed zero, subnormals, finite extrema and zero-to-25600. Quarter texture uses the recovered global binding. Scene depth production and original Metal/game execution are not covered. Each CPU stage consumes the same Vulkan-produced input textures. CPU raster interpolation. Exact float32 bytes, including signed zero. Tests two finite uniform padding patterns. No original Metal execution, hardware intrinsic/filter guarantee, complete Compositor, Windows or game-image parity.
